calm: Curled up next to the terminal.
Dozing with one eye on the log.
happy: All good here. Your code too, I hope.
I watch you work. I approve.
excited: I ran around the rack three times.
hungry: Staring at the bowl with intent.
I'm hungry. One treat unlocks a lot of things.
This isn't blackmail, it's an insistent request.
sleepy: Eyes at half mast. One nap and I'm operational.
asleep: Asleep. Paws twitching: dreaming of cats.
Deep sleep next to the laptop.
sad: Muzzle on the floor. Not many cuddles lately.
Shiba sigh. Very theatrical, a little sincere.

acts.feed.full: Too full. The treat stays on the floor.
acts.feed.treat: Caught the treat mid-air. Reflexes intact.
acts.feed.sniff: Sniffs the full bowl and turns away. Not now.
acts.feed.meal: Bowl empty in twelve seconds. New record.
acts.pet.asleep: Whimpers in his sleep and rolls onto his back.
pet: Leans on your leg. Scratch behind the ear, perfect.
Eyes shut, slow tail. A moment of peace.
Pushes your hand with his muzzle: again.
acts.play.tired: Gives it a try, then lies down. Needs a nap.
play: Pulls the rope with his whole weight. He wins.
Zoomies down the hallway. Three clean laps.
acts.walk.tired: Looks at the leash, then at his bed. Picks the bed.
acts.walk: Went around the block. Sniffed everything, marked almost everything.
acts.nap: Curls up on himself. Nap of %d minutes.
acts.wake: Long yawn and a reproachful look.
acts.trick.refused: "%s"... he stares at you and doesn't move. Shiba.
acts.name.set: From now on he answers to %s. More or less.
acts.reset: New pup, day one. Nice to meet you, I'm %s!
acts.new: A shiba just showed up in your terminal. His name is %s.

deploy: Deploy went through! Running in circles!
In production. Off to celebrate on the rug.
tests-pass: Tests passed, you deserve a treat too.
tests-fail: Red. Ears down, but we've got this.
Tests broken. I'll help you sniff the stack trace.
error: Low growl at the stack trace.
Something's off. I smell a typo.
fixed: Got the bug. Carrying it proudly in my mouth.
apply: An apply. I sit next to you and hold my breath.
Read the plan before saying yes.
long-task: Long task. I'll curl up at your feet and wait.
Waiting nap. Wake me when it's done.
greet: There you are. I kept your seat warm.
bye: Off to my bed. See you later.

tips: Remember to test the feature before calling it done.
A code review before the commit costs less than a rollback after.
Is the commit atomic? If the message has an "and", maybe it's two commits.
Did you update the docs along with the code?
Before an apply, read the plan line by line. Even the boring part.
Secrets in the diff? Take a look before you push.
If the fix shipped to production, does the test covering it exist?
A rebase now costs less than a conflicted merge tomorrow.
Are the new environment variables in the secret too, not just locally?
What happens if this service restarts right now? Do you know, or hope?

tips_ctx.on_main: You're on %s with %d modified files: a dedicated branch costs ten seconds.
tips_ctx.many_files: %d modified files and no commit: still one atomic commit, or three?
tips_ctx.pending: You have %d files pending. A review pass before committing?

help:
Mochi - commands

  mochi                  status card
  mochi feed             full meal
  mochi treat            snack
  mochi pet              mood + bond
  mochi play             big mood boost, costs energy
  mochi walk             biggest gain, biggest cost
  mochi nap [minutes]    nap, 20 by default (rest is 3x faster asleep)
  mochi wake             wake him up
  mochi tricks           what he knows
  mochi trick sit        perform one
  mochi name Kuro        rename
  mochi photo            full-colour PNG (add --open to open it)
  mochi style pixel|ascii|doge
  mochi help

  mochi react <event>    commit | deploy | tests-pass | tests-fail | error
                         fixed | apply | long-task | greet | bye
  mochi tip              a work-hygiene reminder, at most one every 30 min

Output: two lines plus a FACE= line with his colour portrait.
--plain drops FACE, --oneline is a single line, --art draws the sprite as
text, --full adds recent activity.

Stats decay in real time. A meal is refused when he's already full, and
play/walk won't start on an empty tank - he needs a nap first.
